content_of_post_to_comment: I’ve invented a new argument for God’s existence called cloudorain-harmony, I’ve noticed it usually only rains when there are clouds and that is something that would be expected under theism. Under atheism we would expect random rain showers with no clouds, hail going upwards, all that sort of stuff. I will add it to my list of other arguments, all of which are equally as irrefutable.
